title: DNS resolution issues on Linux server
description: Our dev server (Ubuntu 22.04) is failing to resolve internal domain names. Dig command returns SERVFAIL consistently. This is blocking our deployment pipeline.
resolution: Updated the resolv.conf file to point to the correct internal DNS forwarders and cleared the local systemd-resolved cache.

title: Snapshot creation failure
description: The daily snapshot job for the NetApp controller is failing with error 0x80042306. It seems to time out during the VSS writer initialization. Please investigate as we need these for our compliance backups.
resolution: Increased the shadow copy storage limit on the volume to accommodate the increased churn rate of the data.

title: URGENT: Database corruption error
description: System just threw a 'Database page corruption detected' error on the CRM instance! We cannot access any records. Please help, the sales team is panicking!
resolution: Restored the database from the last successful hourly snapshot and performed a checksum validation to ensure data integrity.

title: DHCP Scope Exhaustion
description: We are getting reports that new devices are unable to obtain IP addresses in the Main Office VLAN. Checking the DHCP server logs shows no available addresses in the scope 10.10.20.0/24.
resolution: Extended the DHCP scope mask from /24 to /23 and adjusted the lease time from 8 days to 24 hours to reclaim stale IPs.

title: Suspicious print job
description: I'm seeing print jobs in the queue for a printer in a different building that I didn't send. My username is attached to them. Is someone using my credentials or is the print server glitching?
resolution: Investigated print logs and found a configuration error in the shared printer mapping; reset printer permissions.

title: Need access to the Marketing shared drive
description: Hey, could you please add me to the 'Marketing_Assets' folder? My team lead approved the request. Thanks!
resolution: Added user to the AD security group 'GRP_Marketing_Read_Access' as requested.

title: New hire onboarding access
description: Please provision a standard user account for Sarah Smith in the Finance department. She will need access to Excel Online, Sage, and the shared Finance folder.
resolution: Created AD user object and provisioned licenses for Office 365 and Finance ERP.

title: Data inconsistency in customer table
description: It looks like the user profile table has some corrupted entries where the 'email_verified' flag is NULL instead of false. This is causing our API to crash on production. Please fix ASAP.
resolution: Ran an UPDATE script to set all NULL values to false and applied a NOT NULL constraint on the column to prevent future occurrences.

title: Suspicious login alert
description: I received an automated email stating a login attempt was made from an IP address in a different country. My account is MFA-enabled, but I want to ensure my session hasn't been compromised. Please review logs for user 'jsmith'.
resolution: Reviewed Azure AD sign-in logs and confirmed the suspicious login was an automated API call from a known cloud service; no unauthorized access detected.

title: Suspicious login attempt from unknown location
description: I received an email alert about a successful login to my Microsoft 365 account from an IP address in a country I have never visited. I immediately changed my password, but I am worried that my email data might have been exfiltrated. Please review the sign-in logs for account user_jdoe_88.
resolution: Verified sign-in logs showed a successful MFA bypass attempt. Account locked, forced password reset, and session tokens revoked. User enrolled in hardware-based MFA.

title: Latency in VOIP calls
description: Ever since the new update to our phone system, there is a two-second delay on every call. It’s extremely frustrating for our clients. We are using Polycom VVX 450 handsets.
resolution: Implemented DSCP tagging (EF) for voice traffic across the VLANs to ensure voice packets receive priority queuing over data traffic.

title: Access denied to HR shared drive
description: I transferred from the Marketing department to HR last week, but I still cannot access the 'HR_Records' network drive. My manager said my permissions should have been updated by now.
resolution: Updated the user's Primary Group in Active Directory from 'Marketing_Users' to 'HR_Department_Full'.

title: Request for S3 Bucket Access
description: Hello, I need read-only access to the 'prod-logs-backup' S3 bucket in the AWS environment. My IAM user is 'jsmith_dev'. Please grant the necessary permissions as soon as possible for the audit review.
resolution: Attached the 'ReadOnlyAccess' policy to the user's IAM role after manager approval.

title: Database login credentials
description: Hey, I forgot the password for the dev database. Could you reset it for me? It's the one we use for local testing.
resolution: Generated a new password and sent it via the secure password manager portal.

title: SQL Server connection timeout on App-Prod-01
description: Hey, we're having some trouble with the frontend connecting to the main SQL Server 2019 instance. It’s hitting intermittent "Login timeout expired" errors exactly every 15 minutes, which is preventing users from saving changes in the portal. Any ideas?
resolution: Adjusted the connection pool settings in the web.config and increased the server-side query timeout threshold to resolve locking conflicts.

title: Storage Array Latency Spike
description: Our Nimble storage array is showing significant read/write latency during nightly backup windows. We are seeing IOPS exceeding the controller cache limit, resulting in timeouts for the guest VMs. We suspect a contention issue with the new snapshot schedule.
resolution: Rescheduled snapshot jobs to be staggered by 30-minute intervals to distribute the I/O load across the array controllers.

title: BitLocker recovery screen on boot
description: My Dell Latitude 5420 is stuck on a blue BitLocker recovery screen after a BIOS update this morning. I don't have the 48-digit recovery key and I have a meeting in 10 minutes. This is extremely urgent.
resolution: Retrieved the recovery key from the Azure AD device portal and guided the user through entering it to bypass the lock.

title: Unauthorized Device Alert
description: The NAC system just blocked a device on port 24. MAC address is 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E. It's trying to access the production network.
resolution: Investigated the device and confirmed it was a personal laptop; moved the port to the restricted VLAN.

title: MAC address authentication fail
description: I am trying to connect a new IoT device to the network but it keeps getting rejected by the RADIUS server. Device MAC is 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E.
resolution: Added the device MAC address to the authorized list in the Cisco ISE policy manager.

title: DNS resolution failure
description: Some internal sites aren't resolving correctly today. Seeing SERVFAIL errors when performing nslookup on domain controllers. Very weird.
resolution: Cleared DNS cache on primary DCs and performed a zone transfer refresh; forwarders reconfigured.

title: Unexpected 'Disk Busy' alerts
description: Monitoring tools show 100% disk utilization across multiple servers. It is unclear if a malicious process is hitting the disks or if network congestion is causing queue backups.
resolution: Expanded storage pool capacity and rebalanced LUN distribution to alleviate disk I/O contention.

title: BitLocker recovery prompt
description: My laptop won't boot into Windows 10. It keeps asking for a BitLocker recovery key. I don't know why this happened after the recent firmware update.
resolution: Retrieved the recovery key from the Azure AD portal; successfully bypassed the prompt and verified the drive integrity.

title: iSCSI connection dropping
description: The iSCSI target connection on our secondary backup server keeps flapping. Event ID 34 is appearing every 15 minutes in the System log. Please investigate the switch path.
resolution: Identified a faulty SFP module in the fiber switch; replaced the module and verified link stability.

title: Wi-Fi is super slow in the cafeteria
description: The internet is unusable when I'm eating lunch. My phone drops the signal constantly. It's been like this all week.
resolution: Increased AP power levels and optimized channel selection to mitigate signal interference from the kitchen microwave.

title: Unable to export reports from PowerBI
description: I am trying to export a dashboard to PDF, but the export button is greyed out. My permissions haven't changed, and I am using the desktop version. Please look into this as soon as possible.
resolution: Updated PowerBI Desktop to the latest monthly release; the issue was caused by an expired local authentication token.

title: Suspicious login attempt alert
description: I received an automated email notification about a successful login to my corporate O365 account from an IP address in a country I am not visiting. I have already changed my password, but I am concerned my session tokens were compromised. Please review my account logs for unauthorized access.
resolution: Revoked all active OAuth2 tokens and enforced a global password reset.

title: Physical Security System Offline
description: Our NVR is completely failing again and showing a "Disk Error" on RAID array 0. The server logs clearly point to a dead Disk 2, and as a result, we aren't recording a single second of footage from the main lobby. This is unacceptable and needs to be fixed immediately.
resolution: Hot-swapped the failed 4TB WD Purple drive; RAID array is currently rebuilding successfully.

title: Outlook search not returning results
description: I am writing to formally report a persistent malfunction regarding the search functionality within Outlook 365. When performing a search query, the application consistently returns a "No results found" error, failing to retrieve emails that are confirmed to be present in the inbox. Please note that I have already attempted to resolve this issue by rebuilding the Windows Search index, yet the problem remains unresolved. I request that this matter be escalated for immediate technical investigation and rectification.
resolution: Created a new Outlook profile and re-synced the OST file to resolve a corrupted indexing database.

title: SSD showing SMART errors
description: My workstation (Dell Precision) just warned me during POST that the NVMe drive has SMART event 0x0B. I am worried the drive is going to fail soon. Should I be concerned?
resolution: Verified drive health via vendor utility, confirmed high reallocated sector count, and initiated an emergency disk clone to a spare SSD.

title: Can't connect to VPN
description: Every time I try to connect to the office VPN using Cisco AnyConnect on macOS Monterey, it says 'Connection attempt failed due to invalid server certificate'. It was working fine yesterday morning.
resolution: Updated the root CA certificate on the user's machine as the previous one had expired.

title: NAS Volume Inaccessible
description: Our departmental QNAP TS-873A is completely failing us again, showing a "Volume Degraded" status and leaving the entire team unable to map their network drives on Windows 10. I’ve already wasted time restarting the service, which did absolutely nothing to fix the issue. We need this resolved immediately because we can't get any work done.
resolution: Replaced faulty WD Red Pro 8TB drive in bay 4 and initiated RAID 6 rebuild.

title: Access Request: AWS Production
description: I need read-only access to the Production AWS environment for audit purposes. My supervisor, Sarah Jenkins, has already approved this in the ticketing system. My IAM username is jsmith_ops.
resolution: Attached the 'ReadOnlyAccess' IAM policy to the user's role after verifying manager approval via Jira ticket.

title: Forgotten MFA device
description: I am writing to formally report an issue regarding my inability to access company systems from the office. Due to the inadvertent omission of my company-issued Yubikey, I am currently unable to authenticate via the required Okta prompt. I request an urgent temporary bypass of this authentication protocol to facilitate my work requirements for today.
resolution: Verified identity via manager and issued a one-time bypass code valid for 4 hours.

title: Suspicious login attempt from unknown IP
description: I received an automated email notification regarding a successful login to my Microsoft 365 account from an IP address located in a different country. I have already changed my password, but I want to ensure my account is secure and see if any suspicious mailbox rules were created. Please investigate.
resolution: Confirmed anomalous login from a proxy server. MFA reset forced, session tokens revoked, and mailbox rules audited; no malicious persistence found.

title: Can't login to SAP
description: Hey, I keep getting a 'License limit exceeded' error when I try to log into SAP. It was working fine yesterday, but now it just boots me out immediately. Help?
resolution: Identified a hung session for the user on the SAP application server and performed a forced disconnect of the user ID.

title: Can't save settings in proprietary app
description: I try to change my user preferences in the InternalPortal, but the 'Save' button is grayed out. I've refreshed the browser multiple times. Ugh.
resolution: Provided the user with the correct permission role in the Active Directory group that grants write access to application preferences.

title: Account locked after failed login attempts
description: User is unable to access the system and is receiving an 'Account Locked' message. Unknown if this is due to a password rotation policy or a potential brute-force attack.
resolution: Verify user identity, unlock account, and inspect sign-in logs for suspicious origin IPs.

title: VS Code plugin error
description: The Python extension for VS Code is throwing an error: 'Command 'python.setInterpreter' not found'. This happened right after the recent VS Code update to version 1.88. Any ideas?
resolution: Uninstalled and reinstalled the Python extension, then re-indexed the virtual environment path.

title: Unauthorized USB device detection
description: Our DLP system flagged an event on workstation WS-FIN-04. A user attempted to mount a mass storage device, specifically a SanDisk Ultra, which is unauthorized per our corporate security policy. The action was blocked by the endpoint agent.
resolution: Applied device control policy block to the specific hardware ID. Contacted department manager to reinforce hardware policy.

title: VPN login looping
description: Every time I try to connect to the Cisco AnyConnect VPN, it authenticates via DUO but then immediately disconnects. It says 'Login failed: Certificate validation error'. This is extremely frustrating as I need to finish a deployment before the morning.
resolution: Cleared the expired machine certificate in the certificate manager and re-provisioned the device profile.

title: Browser certificate warning
description: Every site I visit in Chrome is giving me a 'Your connection is not private' error with code NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID. It seems the machine certificate store is missing the company root CA. How do I fix this?
resolution: Re-pushed the Root CA certificate via Group Policy Object to the local certificate store.

title: Cannot access shared network drive
description: Hey, I can't get to the Z: drive anymore. It just says 'Network path not found' when I try to open it. I rebooted my machine but no luck.
resolution: Mapped the drive manually using the server IP address instead of the hostname to bypass a DNS resolution issue on the local subnet.

title: MongoDB replica set sync lag
description: Our secondary nodes are falling significantly behind the primary, showing an optime lag of over 5 minutes. This is causing eventual consistency issues in our microservices environment. We are running Mongo 5.0 on a 3-node cluster.
resolution: Identified high disk I/O contention on the secondary nodes. Resized the EBS volumes and optimized the background indexing processes.

title: Latency issues on internal file server
description: I'm experiencing significant packet loss when trying to pull CAD files from the central server (IP 10.0.4.22). Ping tests show spikes up to 400ms. Is there a bandwidth throttling policy applied to the Engineering VLAN?
resolution: Found a loop in the secondary distribution switch caused by an unauthorized desktop switch plugged into a wall port.

title: UPS Battery Fault Alert
description: Received an automated email alert from the APC Smart-UPS in Rack 4. It says 'Battery replacement required' and 'Temperature high'. Need someone to check this ASAP before the server shuts down.
resolution: Replaced aging lead-acid battery cartridges and cleared the thermal alert from the management console.

title: Account lockout after failed MFA
description: My account has been locked for the third time today. I keep getting an 'Access Denied: Error 0x80048823' when trying to approve the push notification from the Authenticator app on my iPhone 14. Please reset my lockout status immediately.
resolution: Reset AD account lockout and synchronized Azure MFA service principal.

title: Connection refused in Java app
description: Hey, having some trouble with the Java app on node-04—it’s throwing java.net.ConnectException: Connection Refused. We checked the DB server and the firewall ports are definitely open, but netstat shows nothing listening on 3306. Any ideas?
resolution: Restarted the database service which had hung after a kernel update.

title: Change of drive letter for mapped drive
description: Every time I restart my laptop, the mapped network drive changes from H: to K:. It's really frustrating because my shortcut icons keep breaking. Can we just make it stay as H:?
resolution: Updated the GPO (Group Policy Object) to explicitly map the drive letter 'H' and set the action to 'Replace' to ensure consistency.

title: SQL Server connection timeout on App-Prod-01
description: We are seeing intermittent timeout errors when the frontend tries to connect to our primary SQL Server 2019 instance on Windows Server 2019. The error log reports 'Login timeout expired' occurring every 15 minutes. This is affecting user ability to save changes in the portal.
resolution: Adjusted the connection pool settings in the web.config and increased the server-side query timeout threshold to resolve locking conflicts.

title: Firewall block?
description: Our app server (192.168.1.50) cannot ping the database server (172.16.5.10) on port 5432. It was working fine until the network update earlier today.
resolution: Updated the security group ingress rules to allow traffic from the app server's new subnet range.

title: Can't open files in Sharepoint
description: When I click a file in our team SharePoint site, it says I don't have permission to view this item. I'm part of the 'Engineering' group, which should have full access. Please fix this ASAP.
resolution: Updated the SharePoint site collection permissions by re-adding the 'Engineering' group to the 'Members' role.

title: Intermittent packet loss on main server uplink
description: Hey, heads up—we’re seeing about 15% packet loss on the SFP+ uplink between the server rack and the distribution switch. It looks like it started right after that fiber patch cable got moved during the site audit. The latency spikes are causing SQL timeouts, so we might need to take a look at that connection.
resolution: Replaced the damaged OM4 fiber patch cable which showed high insertion loss during testing.

title: Account locked again!
description: I am writing to formally report a recurring technical issue regarding my user account, which has experienced unauthorized lockouts on three separate occasions this week. These incidents have repeatedly interrupted critical client meetings and significantly hindered my professional productivity. I request an immediate investigation into the root cause of these lockouts and a permanent resolution to ensure consistent system access moving forward.
resolution: Identified an old iPad still trying to sync email with an expired password; removed the device from the ActiveSync list.

title: Adobe Acrobat PDF printing issue
description: When I print PDFs from Acrobat DC, the images come out completely black. I have to print them as images to get them to look right, but that takes forever. Windows 11 system.
resolution: Updated the printer driver to the latest PCL6 version and disabled the 'Print as Image' setting by default.

title: Production server firewall failure
description: Hi team, just a heads up that the production environment is completely inaccessible to all remote workers. Not a huge deal, but if someone could investigate when they finish their coffee, that would be great.
resolution: Updated firewall security rules to allow traffic from the VPN subnet.

title: Corrupt database - lost all records
description: I'm having a spot of tea and noticed that our primary database volume shows 0 bytes remaining and all files are missing. Just mentioning it in case you feel like poking around later today.
resolution: Identified rogue cleanup script that wiped the data volume. Restored database from hourly snapshot.

title: OneDrive sync conflict
description: I have multiple files stuck in a sync conflict loop in OneDrive for Business. It's creating duplicate copies of my project files every time I save. My laptop is running out of space.
resolution: Unlinked and relinked the OneDrive account to force a fresh sync of the metadata files.

title: DHCP Scope Exhaustion
description: The Finance subnet (10.10.50.0/24) is out of available IP addresses. New devices are failing to pull an IP, receiving APIPA addresses instead. We need to expand the scope.
resolution: Increased the DHCP scope range from /24 to /23 and cleared inactive leases from the server.

title: Slow internet speeds in Building B
description: I've noticed that browsing internal sites is extremely slow today. Speed tests show barely 5Mbps while connected via Ethernet. Is there maintenance happening in this sector?
resolution: Identified a faulty SFP module on the distribution switch causing CRC errors; replaced the module.

title: ORA-00060 deadlock detected
description: Our application is throwing ORA-00060 errors on Oracle 19c. It seems to happen specifically when multiple service accounts attempt to update the 'Inventory_Master' table simultaneously. This is unacceptable as it crashes our warehouse sync every day at noon.
resolution: Optimized the transaction isolation levels and modified the application code to implement a retry logic with exponential backoff.

title: Admin rights request
description: I need local administrator rights on my laptop to install some software for my project. The software is 'Advanced Network Tools'. Please grant this ASAP.
resolution: Denied request based on security policy; offered to push the software via SCCM once vetted by the security team.

title: Slow upload speeds
description: I'm trying to upload a 2GB video file to the marketing folder, but it's crawling at 50kbps. Usually, it’s much faster. Is there a maintenance task running on the network?
resolution: Cleared the queue on the local traffic shaper that was prioritizing VOIP traffic over file transfers.

title: Unable to export reports from PowerBI
description: Getting an error whenever I try to export to PDF in PowerBI Desktop version 2.124. I keep seeing 'Internal Error: 0x80040154'. I am running this on a Windows 10 VM with 16GB of RAM.
resolution: Updated the WebView2 runtime on the VM as the existing version was incompatible with the current PowerBI build.

title: Browser certificate error
description: Every time I try to access our internal HR portal, Chrome shows 'Your connection is not private' with code NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID. It’s making it impossible to submit my expenses.
resolution: Re-installed the internal root certificate authority in the system trust store and cleared the browser HSTS cache.

title: Deadlock detected
description: The application logs on Linux-App-02 show frequent deadlock errors during the batch import process. It's happening every time the inventory sync runs. This is causing data inconsistencies.
resolution: Modified the application code to implement row-level locking instead of table-level locking for the batch import process.

title: Out of disk space on DB server
description: SQL-PROD-01 is throwing error 1105: Could not allocate space for object in database 'PROD_DATA' because the 'PRIMARY' filegroup is full. We are unable to process new transactions. Please expand the LUN or clear logs.
resolution: Extended the virtual disk by 200GB via VMware vSphere and expanded the NTFS partition in Windows Server 2019.

title: DNS resolution failing for internal resources
description: Users are reporting that internal apps like hr.company.local are failing to resolve. Primary DC (Windows Server 2019) is showing Event ID 4013, indicating the DNS server is unable to open the AD integrated zone. This is affecting all departments.
resolution: Restarted the DNS Server service and forced a synchronization with the secondary DNS controller.

title: VPN gateway timeout
description: Hey, is the VPN down? I’m having trouble getting onto the network—Cisco AnyConnect on my Mac just keeps timing out with a 404 error. Any ideas?
resolution: Reset the VPN authentication service on the perimeter firewall.

title: Query performance issues
description: My reports are taking forever to run today. Usually takes 30 seconds, now it's timing out after 10 minutes. Please help.
resolution: Added missing index on the 'Orders' table to support the filtered index scan.

title: Intermittent packet loss on VLAN 20
description: I'm seeing sporadic packet loss on the production VLAN 20. Traceroute shows delays at the distribution layer hop. It's affecting all VM hosts attached to Host-Cluster-A.
resolution: Identified a spanning-tree topology change loop caused by a misconfigured secondary switch; corrected STP priority settings.

title: WLAN auth failures
description: Multiple users on macOS Monterey are unable to authenticate to the 802.1X WPA2-Enterprise network. They keep getting prompted for credentials but the auth server rejects the certificate.
resolution: Updated the RADIUS server root certificate on all managed devices via MDM profile push.

title: Possible unauthorized login
description: I received an automated email notification about a sign-in to my Microsoft 365 account from an IP address in a country I'm not currently visiting. I’ve already changed my password, but I'm concerned my local session might still be compromised.
resolution: Revoked all active OAuth tokens and forced a global logout across all devices.

title: Hyper-V Host 'HV-PROD-02' unresponsive
description: Host HV-PROD-02 is showing as 'Not Responding' in Failover Cluster Manager. The iDRAC is accessible, but the OS appears to be hanging on the blue screen during a kernel dump. This host manages our core SQL workloads.
resolution: Performed a hard power cycle via iDRAC. Updated NIC drivers to address a known memory leak causing the bugcheck.

title: Slack notification sounds missing
description: My Slack notifications have stopped making sounds entirely. I've checked my system settings on macOS and the Slack preferences, but everything looks correct. Any ideas?
resolution: Updated Slack to the latest version and reset the notification sound scheme in settings.

title: ERP module fails to load dashboard widgets
description: Dashboard widgets in the ERP remain stuck on the loading spinner. Users can browse other parts of the site without issue.
resolution: Cleared corrupted server-side cache files that were causing the widget API calls to fail.

title: Account locked out after multiple failed attempts
description: My domain account is locked again. I was working on my MacBook Pro M2, and it just stopped letting me log into the VPN. I'm pretty sure I typed the password correctly, but now it says 5 failed attempts.
resolution: Unlocked account in Active Directory and cleared cached credentials on the local keychain. Advised user to check for hung processes in the background.

title: Latency spikes in VLAN 20
description: This correspondence serves to formally document persistent performance degradation affecting Finance department personnel while accessing cloud-based ERP resources. Network diagnostic analysis, specifically traceroute data, isolates the source of these latency spikes to the Distribution Layer switch, identified as DIST-SW-02. Furthermore, current monitoring confirms that CPU utilization on the switch backplane is exhibiting critical fluctuations between 85% and 95%, indicating a severe hardware or configuration deficiency that requires immediate remediation.
resolution: Identified a broadcast storm caused by a loop on an unmanaged switch in the Finance office; removed the rogue device and implemented port security.

title: MFA prompt not appearing
description: I am writing to formally report an ongoing technical issue regarding the ERP system authentication process. Despite maintaining a stable network connection and ensuring that the Duo mobile application is updated to the latest available version, I am failing to receive the required push notifications necessary to complete the login procedure. This persistent failure in the authentication workflow is preventing me from accessing the system and is effectively obstructing my ability to perform my professional responsibilities for the day. I request an immediate investigation into this matter to restore my access.
resolution: Resynchronized the user's Duo token in the admin dashboard and cleared the local cache on the mobile device.

title: SSL Certificate Expiration
description: Our load balancer LB-PROD-EXT is showing an expiration warning for the wildcard certificate. It expires in 3 days. We need to replace this immediately.
resolution: Renewed SSL certificate via DigiCert and deployed the new PFX file to the load balancer.

title: Account locked out again
description: My account keeps getting locked out every hour. I'm using a Dell Latitude 5420 on Windows 11. I haven't changed my password, and I'm not running any scheduled tasks that I know of. This is very frustrating as I have a deadline.
resolution: Identified a stale credential in Windows Credential Manager linked to a disconnected network drive mapped to an old server.

title: Latency spikes during high-traffic periods
description: System performance degrades significantly every Monday morning during the weekly backup sync. Operations team cannot determine if it is a bandwidth or disk throughput issue.
resolution: Reconfigured storage array caching policies to prevent IOPS saturation during high-load backup windows.

title: Performance degradation on SAN volume
description: The SQL server cluster is experiencing high latency on the data drive. IOPS monitoring shows a massive spike in read/write times during 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM. We suspect the storage fabric is saturated.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured backup job running during business hours; adjusted the schedule to run during the maintenance window.

title: Internal Portal 403 Forbidden error
description: I cannot access the HR portal. I am getting a 403 Forbidden error every time I navigate to the benefits page. I have already tried logging out and back in.
resolution: Updated user permissions in Active Directory to reflect the new department security group.

title: System Access Denied
description: I'm getting an 'Access Denied: 0x80070005' when trying to run the proprietary inventory software on my Dell Latitude laptop. This has been happening since the last Windows Update.
resolution: Corrected file system permissions on the application installation directory.

title: Rack fan failure
description: I noticed the cooling fan at the bottom of Server-Rack-1 is making a high-pitched whistling noise and stopped spinning. The ambient temp in the rack is rising quickly.
resolution: Replaced the failed 120mm exhaust fan assembly with a spare unit from inventory.

title: Unable to reach external website
description: I cannot access our vendor portal at portal.vendor-site.com. I'm getting a DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN error in Chrome. Everything else on the internet works fine for me.
resolution: Flushed DNS cache on the local machine and updated the primary DNS server settings to resolve the unreachable subdomain.

title: VPN connection failing
description: I am formally reporting a persistent technical issue regarding connectivity to the corporate network via the GlobalProtect VPN client. Despite successfully authorizing the Duo push notification, the application consistently returns an "Authentication Failed" error message, preventing any network access. This issue is occurring on a device running macOS Sonoma 14.2. Please investigate this authentication failure as a matter of priority.
resolution: Updated the GlobalProtect client certificate on the user's device and cleared the cached SAML assertion in the browser.

title: Help with SQL syntax
description: I'm trying to join two tables and it's not working. I keep getting a syntax error near the 'ON' keyword. I'm using MySQL Workbench on Windows 11.
resolution: Corrected the join condition syntax and added aliases to clarify the columns being pulled from each table.

title: Cannot map network drive Z:
description: I keep getting a 'Network Path Not Found' error when trying to map the Z drive on my MacBook Pro running macOS Sonoma. I'm connected to the office VPN, but the SMB share isn't resolving by name.
resolution: Added the file server's FQDN to the local hosts file as a temporary workaround and verified VPN routing table entries.

title: Can't login to Jira
description: Hey, quick heads up—I’m running into a 403 Forbidden error when trying to log into Jira with SSO. It was working perfectly yesterday, but no luck today. I'm on macOS Sonoma using Chrome. Any ideas?
resolution: Synced user's Okta profile with the Atlassian cloud tenant to resolve attribute synchronization delay.

title: SSD failure on workstation
description: I am writing to formally report a critical hardware failure involving my workstation. The system experienced an unexpected termination resulting in a Blue Screen of Death, specifically citing the error code CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED. Subsequent to a mandatory reboot, the system BIOS failed to detect the Samsung 980 Pro NVMe drive. This drive contains sensitive client documentation that has not been backed up; therefore, I request an immediate escalation to address this data integrity concern and restore access to these files.
resolution: SSD controller failed. Replaced drive under warranty and performed data recovery on the damaged NAND flash.

title: Routine DB user request
description: Could you please create a new database user 'dev_tester' with read-only permissions on the 'sandbox' schema? Thanks.
resolution: Created the user with restricted SELECT-only permissions on the sandbox schema.

title: Update failed: Security patch KB5034441
description: My machine refuses to install the latest Windows security patch, KB5034441. It fails with error code 0x80070643 every single time I restart. Can someone fix this?
resolution: Manually resized the Recovery Partition (WinRE) to accommodate the package size. Successfully applied the patch and verified system integrity.

title: Domain Controller NTP sync
description: We are seeing a massive drift in time synchronization across the domain. Server DC01 is 5 minutes ahead of the PDC emulator, causing Kerberos authentication failures.
resolution: Reconfigured the PDC to sync with an external stratum-1 NTP source and forced a w32tm /resync on all DCs.

title: Data breach detected
description: Excuse me, but I believe unauthorized users are currently exporting our client financial records. Whenever you have a chance to peek at the server logs, I'd appreciate it. Thanks!
resolution: Terminated unauthorized sessions and forced a global password reset for administrative accounts.

title: Guest Wi-Fi portal not loading
description: The captive portal for the guest network isn't popping up on mobile devices. Users are stuck at the 'Connected, No Internet' state. We need this fixed for the conference tomorrow.
resolution: Restarted the WLC controller service and flushed the DNS entries for the portal redirect URL.

title: VPN access is busted again
description: Hey, I'm trying to connect to the office VPN using the Cisco AnyConnect client on Windows 11, but it keeps throwing error 442. I've restarted my laptop twice and checked my home Wi-Fi, but nothing works. Please fix this, I have a deadline.
resolution: Updated the Cisco AnyConnect client to the latest version and re-registered the virtual miniport adapter.

title: Intermittent packet loss on Site-to-Site VPN
description: Our remote office in Austin is reporting heavy packet loss (approx 15%) when accessing internal file shares. Traceroute shows high latency specifically at the hop involving the FortiGate 100F gateway at our primary DC. Firmware is currently at v7.0.5.
resolution: Identified MTU mismatch on the tunnel interface; adjusted MTU size to 1400 bytes to prevent fragmentation.

title: VPN connection failing with Error 809
description: My Cisco AnyConnect client keeps throwing Error 809 when I try to connect from home. I've restarted my router and updated my Windows 11 machine, but it still won't establish the tunnel. I need this to access the shared drive by EOD.
resolution: Modified client-side registry settings to allow UDP encapsulation for NAT-T, resolving the blocked IKEv2 traffic.

title: Database disk space alert
description: The mount point /var/lib/mysql is at 98% capacity. We need to clear some logs or extend the volume. Please advise.
resolution: Purged binary logs older than 7 days and extended the LVM volume by 100GB to provide sufficient headroom for future growth.

title: Upgrade request for dev instance
description: We need to upgrade the PostgreSQL version on our staging environment from 12 to 15. Please let us know when this can be scheduled.
resolution: Scheduled the upgrade for the maintenance window this coming Saturday. Notified the stakeholders.

title: Can't connect to Mongo cluster
description: Getting 'ServerSelectionTimeoutError' when trying to hit the MongoDB Atlas cluster from my laptop. I'm on the office VPN. Is the IP whitelisted?
resolution: Added the current office subnet CIDR range to the MongoDB Atlas IP Access List.

title: ISP trunk line severed
description: Good morning. Just a quick heads-up that the external ISP fiber line was accidentally cut by a construction crew outside. We are currently operating at zero connectivity. It would be great if we could resolve this soon. Thanks for your help.
resolution: Coordinated with ISP to splice the damaged fiber line.

title: External HDD not detected
description: My WD MyPassport drive isn't showing up in File Explorer on Windows 11. It makes a faint clicking noise when I plug it in. I really need the files on here for the presentation at 2 PM.
resolution: Confirmed physical drive failure; recommended data recovery specialist as the drive is making mechanical clicking sounds.

title: Browser extension interfering with payroll site
description: The payroll portal won't load the final submit button. It seems like something is blocking the script. Can you check this?
resolution: Identified that an ad-blocking browser extension was flagging the payroll portal's submission script as malicious; added site to whitelist.

title: Data inconsistency in UserReports table
description: I noticed that the UserReports table is showing duplicate entries for user IDs generated between 09:00 and 10:00 UTC today. It seems like the primary key constraint failed to trigger for some reason. This is impacting our executive dashboards.
resolution: Found that the constraint was accidentally set to 'NOT VALID' during a previous schema migration. Ran a full data cleanup and re-validated the primary key.

title: Unable to log into Salesforce
description: The login page is just showing a white screen after I hit 'Sign In'. I've tried Chrome and Edge. It worked perfectly yesterday on my desktop. I have an important client demo in an hour.
resolution: Cleared site-specific cookies and browser cache; updated Salesforce SSO metadata.

title: Cannot access internal server - 403 Forbidden
description: I'm getting a 403 Forbidden error when trying to access the dev-web-01 internal server on our intranet. I was able to reach it fine yesterday. My permissions haven't changed.
resolution: Identified that the user's AD group membership was not propagating to the server's ACL due to a replication lag; forced an update of the security token.

title: Lost connection to the SAN
description: Hosts 01 through 04 just dropped their iSCSI connections. We are seeing 'Device Path Degraded' errors in vCenter. Everything is currently offline.
resolution: Rebooted the secondary storage controller which had hung due to a firmware memory leak.

title: Cannot access internal SharePoint portal
description: When I try to navigate to portal.internal, I get a 404 error, but my colleagues have no problem. I've cleared my Chrome cache and flushed DNS, but it persists. Is my AD account locked out of the network?
resolution: Updated the local hosts file which had stale entries pointing to the old decommissioned load balancer IP address.

title: SQL Server Management Studio connection timeout
description: I'm attempting to connect to the staging database via SSMS 19.1, but I am receiving a 'Connection Timeout Expired' error. The network team confirmed the VPN is active, and I can ping the server IP successfully. Could you check if my credentials have expired in the Active Directory group?
resolution: Reset the user's domain password which had reached the mandatory 90-day expiration threshold.

title: Office printer offline
description: The printer in the North Wing is showing as offline on all machines. We have a meeting in 10 minutes and need to print the quarterly reports. Please check the network switch port.
resolution: Reset the static IP configuration on the printer and power-cycled the local PoE switch.

title: DB Access Issue
description: Receiving an 'ORA-01017: invalid username/password' error when connecting to the production Oracle database via SQL Developer. I am using my standard company credentials.
resolution: Verified the user was missing from the DBA_USERS whitelist. Added user to the correct Oracle database role.

title: Fiber link degradation
description: Monitoring tools are alerting on high latency between the main office and the remote branch. The link is showing intermittent packet loss around 5%.
resolution: Identified a bent fiber patch cord at the cross-connect panel and replaced it with a new OM4 LC-LC cable.

title: Excel Add-in failing to load
description: The custom company data feed add-in in Excel is failing with a runtime error 1004. This started happening after I installed the most recent Office 365 security patch.
resolution: Trusted the add-in file location in the Excel Trust Center settings.

title: Permission denied on file share
description: Every time I try to save a document to the department share (\fileserverinance), I get a 'Permission Denied' error. I am logged in as jdoe and I've been able to access this folder for years. Did something change with the AD groups?
resolution: Updated the user's Active Directory security token to reflect recent changes in the Finance-ReadOnly group membership.

title: Urgent: Lost Badge/Building Access
description: I have misplaced my security badge and cannot enter the building this morning. I'm currently waiting in the lobby. Please disable the lost card and issue me a temporary access credential.
resolution: Deactivated the lost badge ID 99284 in the LenelS2 system and issued a temporary visitor pass.

title: BitLocker recovery key requested
description: I booted up my Dell Latitude 5420 this morning and it's stuck on a blue screen asking for a BitLocker recovery key. It says 'Enter the recovery key to get going again.' I don't know where to find this.
resolution: Retrieved recovery key from Azure AD portal and provided it to the user. Verified TPM state and updated BIOS to prevent further lockout.

title: SSD wear level alert
description: I am writing to formally report that our server monitoring system has issued an alert indicating that the solid-state drives (SSDs) within our cache tier have reached a 92% wear level. Although the system currently remains operational, I am concerned regarding the long-term stability of this hardware. Please provide a formal assessment of the urgency of this issue and advise on the required timeframe for scheduling a proactive replacement to prevent potential service disruption.
resolution: Analyzed the S.M.A.R.T. data and confirmed the drives are still within operational spec; scheduled a proactive replacement for the next quarterly maintenance cycle.

title: Potential Phishing Email
description: I received an email claiming to be from the IT department asking me to 'verify my credentials' at a link that looks like a misspelled version of our internal portal. I haven't clicked anything, but I wanted to make sure you were aware.
resolution: Confirmed phishing attempt, added malicious URL to global blacklist, and purged email from all employee inboxes.

title: Access to Jira board denied
description: I'm trying to view the 'Q3 Infrastructure Project' board in Jira, but I'm getting an 'Insufficient Permissions' message. My teammates can see it just fine. Can you check my profile settings?
resolution: Added user to the 'Jira_Infrastructure_Project' permission scheme.

title: Why is the internet so bad?
description: I am writing to formally report a persistent and severe degradation in system performance across all applications, including email services and web browsers. This issue is significantly impeding my ability to work. Please investigate whether there is an ongoing server outage or infrastructure instability contributing to this widespread latency.
resolution: Identified high bandwidth usage from a user running a P2P application and blocked the port.

title: Database replication lag
description: The read replica is lagging by over 45 minutes. We are running MySQL 8.0 on AWS RDS. This is causing significant issues for our data analysts who need real-time data.
resolution: Identified a long-running transaction on the master node that was blocking the relay log application. Terminated the session and cleared the lag.

title: Adobe CC License failure
description: Whenever I launch Photoshop, it tells me I don't have a valid subscription. I'm signed in with my work email, but it keeps redirecting me to the 'Start Trial' page. Is there an issue with the license pool?
resolution: Assigned an available seat from the Adobe Admin Console to the user's email address.

title: Screen locker GPO failure
description: I noticed that the screens on our lab machines running Windows 10 LTSC aren't locking after 15 minutes of inactivity. We need this for HIPAA compliance. Please investigate why the GPO isn't applying.
resolution: Found a conflicting local policy setting. Overwrote local policy with domain GPO using gpupdate /force.

title: Unable to extend logical volume
description: I'm trying to extend our /data partition on RHEL 8, but the 'lvextend' command fails with 'Insufficient free space'. I added a new 500GB virtual disk to the VM but it doesn't seem to be visible to the LVM subsystem.
resolution: Rescanned the SCSI bus using 'echo "- - -" > /sys/class/scsi_host/host0/scan', initialized the new physical volume, and successfully extended the volume group.

title: Data synchronization failures
description: Remote branch offices are failing to sync with central SQL server. Could be a VPN tunnel issue or DB lock contention.
resolution: Increased MTU size settings on the VPN tunnel to prevent packet fragmentation.

title: THE WORLD IS ENDING!!!
description: I noticed that one of the internal test environment tables has a typo in the column header. My life is ruined, please fix this immediately before I lose my mind!!!
resolution: Corrected column label 'Usrname' to 'Username' in the staging database.

title: Jira plugin incompatibility
description: Since the recent Jira server upgrade, our custom reporting plugin is throwing a '500 Internal Server Error'. The logs indicate a dependency conflict with the new Java runtime environment.
resolution: Updated the plugin to version 2.4.1 to ensure compatibility with the updated Java environment.

title: External HDD not mounting
description: I'm trying to plug in my Seagate Backup Plus drive into my MacBook Pro (macOS Sonoma). It shows up in Disk Utility, but it won't mount as a volume. It just says 'com.apple.DiskManagement.disenter error 49153'.
resolution: Ran First Aid in Disk Utility and repaired the corrupted file system structure on the partition.

title: Storage quota limit reached
description: System notification says I've reached the 10GB limit on my home directory. I'm not even sure what's taking up that much space. Can someone help me clear it out?
resolution: Located a hidden temp folder containing local browser profile bloat; cleared the data and increased the home directory quota.

title: Urgent: Salesforce access for client demo
description: I have a client demo in 20 minutes and my Salesforce access is completely gone. It says 'User account inactive'. I really need this fixed immediately, please!
resolution: Reactivated the user account which had been flagged by an automated cleanup script for 90 days of inactivity.

title: Salesforce login loop
description: My Salesforce instance keeps redirecting me back to the login page after I enter my MFA code. I've tried clearing my Chrome cache and cookies, but the issue persists. Using macOS Sonoma 14.2.
resolution: Detected an expired session token in the user's browser profile; cleared site data specifically for the Salesforce domain.

title: Printer on 2nd floor is unreachable
description: The LaserJet Pro M402n on the 2nd floor has disappeared from the network. Employees are receiving 'Host Unreachable' errors when trying to print documents. I have verified that the Ethernet cable is securely plugged in, but the printer's status light is solid amber.
resolution: Reset the static IP configuration on the printer interface and assigned it a new reserved address via DHCP.

title: Adobe Acrobat Pro crashing on startup
description: Every time I open a PDF, Acrobat crashes instantly with error code 0xc0000005. I'm running the latest version on macOS Sonoma. This is holding up my contract reviews.
resolution: Performed a clean re-installation of Adobe Acrobat using the Adobe Cleaner Tool to remove residual registry entries.

title: Application 'Connection Refused' error
description: The application cannot reach the database server. Testing shows the server is up, but the port is unreachable from the app tier.
resolution: Updated firewall rules that were inadvertently flushed during a security appliance patch.

title: Teams file upload error
description: Unable to upload any files to the team channel. Getting an error code 403 Forbidden. Using Microsoft Teams version 24004.1309.
resolution: Cleared the Teams cache files and re-authenticated the user's session.

title: Intermittent packet loss on main server uplink
description: We are seeing 15% packet loss on the SFP+ uplink between the server rack and the distribution switch. It started after the fiber patch cable was moved during the site audit. Latency spikes are causing SQL timeouts.
resolution: Replaced the damaged OM4 fiber patch cable which showed high insertion loss during testing.

title: Critical latency on main uplink
description: We are seeing huge latency spikes across the entire office network. Ping times to the gateway are jumping from 2ms to 400ms sporadically. This is affecting everyone.
resolution: Identified a broadcast storm caused by a loop on an unmanaged switch; physically disconnected the loop.

title: Schema sync failure
description: The staging environment isn't matching production. Schema migration script v2.4 failed with a syntax error near 'MODIFY COLUMN'. OS is CentOS 7.
resolution: Fixed invalid syntax in migration file and ran the apply script manually.

title: VMs entering 'Read Only' mode
description: Several virtual machines have suddenly locked up and are reporting file system errors. Guest OS logs are inconclusive regarding the root cause.
resolution: Identified a corrupted SAN controller firmware causing intermittent write-access drops to the VMFS datastore.

title: Outlook missing search results
description: Outlook search is acting up again. It is not showing any emails received after last Tuesday. I have tried rebuilding the index via Windows Search Options, but that didn't help. Is there a fix for this?
resolution: Repaired the Outlook data file (.ost) using the SCANPST.EXE utility and restarted the Windows Search service.

title: Cannot access shared drive
description: Getting an error message when trying to access the \\FileServer01\Marketing drive. It says 'Network path not found' (Error 0x80070035). Running Windows 10 Pro.
resolution: Flushed DNS cache and re-mapped the network drive using the server's static IP address instead of the hostname.

title: Drive failure in RAID array
description: Hey, the storage controller on server SRV-PROD-04 is beeping. The management console shows Disk 3 in the RAID 5 array has a status of 'Failed'. Please send someone to replace it ASAP.
resolution: Physically swapped the faulty drive and initiated a RAID rebuild which completed successfully after 4 hours.

title: Core Switch Uplink Flapping
description: We are seeing intermittent connectivity loss on the primary uplink port (Te1/0/1) of the distribution switch, Cisco Catalyst 9300. Logs indicate 'ERR_DISABLE' events triggered by link flapping every 15-20 minutes. This is causing latency spikes for the entire third-floor VLAN.
resolution: Replaced the SFP+ transceiver and patched the fiber cable; port stability restored.

title: Network printer offline
description: Our HP LaserJet Pro in the marketing department is showing as offline on all workstations. The printer LCD shows it has an IP address, but we can't ping it from the server. Can you help?
resolution: Reassigned a static IP address to the printer via DHCP reservation, as the previous IP was conflicting with a new VOIP phone.

title: Salesforce desktop app crashes on startup
description: The Salesforce desktop application is crashing immediately upon launch on my MacBook Pro running macOS Sonoma 14.2. I have tried reinstalling the application and clearing the cache, but it still throws a 'SIGABRT' error code in the logs. Can someone assist me with this?
resolution: Updated the Salesforce CLI and cleared the ~/Library/Application Support/Salesforce directory to resolve the corrupted configuration files.

title: Intermittent file access timeouts
description: Users are reporting sporadic 30-second delays when opening files from the shared network drive. The issue seems to impact different departments at random intervals.
resolution: Upgraded core network switches to resolve intermittent packet loss causing SMB session timeouts.

title: System Access Denied
description: I can't even get our proprietary inventory software to open on my Dell Latitude because of this constant Access Denied: 0x80070005 error. It was working perfectly fine until the latest Windows Update broke everything. I need this fixed immediately so I can actually do my job.
resolution: Corrected file system permissions on the application installation directory.

title: Account lockout on domain controller
description: I keep getting locked out of my AD account every 15 minutes. The event logs on DC01 show event ID 4740 with source machine DESKTOP-9X2L1. I have already cleared my cached credentials in Windows Credential Manager, but the issue persists.
resolution: Cleared stale stored credentials on the user's laptop and forced a group policy update to synchronize account lock policies.
